layout_architecture.structure: Standard Dashboard Layout with Collapsible Left Navigation, Top Bar, and Main Content Canvas

sidebar.behavior_mobile: Fixed drawer overlay with transition slide-in-out (z-50)

header.elements: Breadcrumb path, Search trigger modal button, System Status Indicator (Gmail Connected / Syncing), Dark/Light Toggle, Quick Test Email Action, Admin Profile Dropdown

top_graph_banner.description: High-density Recharts area & bar composition placed at the top of the Overview panel showcasing real inquiry volume, email reward delivery rate, and status breakdown over time

overview.graph: Recharts AreaChart / ResponsiveContainer with Gradient Fills for Inquiry volume vs Email confirmations sent

inquiries_management.details_modal: Drawer showing full inquiry message, assigned admin dropdown, delivery logs for Google App Password auto-thank-you email, and 'Resend Reward Email' button with loader

preserved_sections.search_console: Search metrics, indexing status, top queries, and crawl health
preserved_sections.whatsapp_alerts: WhatsApp webhook status, notification triggers, phone logs
preserved_sections.pipeline: Deal stage funnel (Lead -> Contacted -> Quoted -> Closed Won)
preserved_sections.facts: Platform telemetry and quick stats overview
preserved_sections.exports: CSV and PDF automated report generator with date range selection

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, explicit on buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, and metric cards
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standards: WCAG AA / APCA compliant, 4.5:1 min contrast ratio for body text, explicitly defined hover states with high contrast

instructions_to_main_agent: Build/refactor React components inside /app/frontend/src/components/admin/ using JavaScript (.js or .jsx) syntax.
Ensure the Admin Dashboard includes a fixed left sidebar on desktop and collapsible sheet/drawer on mobile screens.
Place the main Recharts area/bar chart prominently at the top of the Overview panel.
Implement the Gmail & Google App Password settings panel with a working test email simulation using Sonner toasts.
Ensure Inquiry management features detailed status tracking and automatic thank-you email status indicators.
Provide Blog management (Create/Edit/Publish/Delete) with a public reading modal preview.
Preserve and style all existing sections: Search Console, WhatsApp Alerts, Pipeline, Facts, and Exports.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all interactive elements as listed in testing_and_accessibility.
